sponsored.t: Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements
sponsored.sum: Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements; removes such tax on permanent residents.

sponsored.t: Reestablishes the office of coroner in the county of Oswego and removing the powers and duties of coroners from the district attorney in such county and allows Oswego County to appoint a coroner
sponsored.sum: Reestablishes the office of coroner in the county of Oswego; removes the powers and duties of coroners from the district attorney in such county; allows Oswego County to appoint a coroner.

sponsored.t: Exempts the Caughdenoy Volunteer Fire Department, Inc. from the forty-five percent limit on non-resident members
sponsored.sum: Exempts the Caughdenoy Volunteer Fire Department, Inc., within the town of Central Square, Oswego county from the forty-five percent limit on non-resident members.

sponsored.t: Exempts the Cody Volunteer Fire Department, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership
sponsored.sum: Exempts the Cody Volunteer Fire Department, Inc. within the town of Granby, Oswego county, from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership.

sponsored.t: Permits the Oswego city school district to create an insurance reserve fund
sponsored.sum: Provides that the Oswego city school district may establish an insurance reserve fund.

sponsored.t: Permits the town of Redfield, Oswego county, to designate certain roads as minimum maintenance roads
sponsored.sum: Permits the town of Redfield, Oswego county, to designate certain roads as minimum maintenance roads.

sponsored.t: Exempts school districts located within a nuclear emergency planning zone from zero-emission school bus requirements
sponsored.sum: Exempts any school district located wholly or partially within a ten-mile plume exposure pathway emergency planning zone surrounding a nuclear power facility from the requirements of only purchasing or leasing zero-emission school buses and only operating and maintaining zero-emission school buses.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing for the recall of a district attorney
sponsored.sum: Provides for the recall of a district attorney.

sponsored.t: Relates to amending the constitution to prohibit an immediate vote to be called on budget bills
sponsored.sum: Amends the constitution to prohibit an immediate vote from being called by the governor or acting governor on any budget bills.

sponsored.t: Relates to the right to bear and keep arms
sponsored.sum: Relates to the right of the people to bear and keep arms.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of the small business child & dependent care savings program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the small business child and dependent care savings program; provides the basic framework therefor.

sponsored.t: Makes the first one hundred thousand dollars of an individuals' private pension non-taxable
sponsored.sum: Makes the first one hundred thousand dollars of an individual's private pension non-taxable.

sponsored.t: Prohibits distribution of a decedent's estate to certain sex offenders
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a distributive share from passing to a person convicted of committing or attempting to commit a sex offense.

sponsored.t: Makes certain state lands in the county of Oswego subject to taxation for all purposes
sponsored.sum: Makes certain state lands in the towns of Albion, Amboy, Boylston, Constantia, Parish, West Monroe and Williamstown, in the county of Oswego, subject to taxation for all purposes.

sponsored.t: Creates an assembly standing committee on ethics and guidance
sponsored.sum: Creates an assembly standing committee on ethics and guidance of eight members.

sponsored.t: Relates to ensuring all students enrolled at state university of New York and city university of New York institutions are able to express themselves freely without fear of intimidation or harm
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring the regents to adopt a policy that ensures all students enrolled at state university of New York and city university of New York institutions are able to express themselves freely without fear of intimidation or harm.

sponsored.t: Relates to commission of murder in the first degree; provides that sentence for commission of certain provisions of murder in the first degree is death or life without parole
sponsored.sum: Includes intentionally selecting a victim based on certain actual or perceived traits in the crime of murder in the first degree; provides that sentence for commission of certain provisions of murder in the first degree is death or life without parole.

sponsored.t: Includes offenses involving the possession, display or discharge of certain firearms as qualifying offenses for the purpose of allowing a principal to be eligible to be held on bail
sponsored.sum: Includes offenses involving the possession, display or discharge of a firearm, rifle, shotgun, machine-gun, or disguised gun as qualifying offenses for the purpose of allowing a principal to be eligible to be held on bail.

sponsored.t: Prohibits municipal corporations from adopting local laws, ordinances, regulations, or policies that prohibit certain utility services from being delivered based on the type or source of energy
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the governing board of a municipal corporation from adopting any law, ordinance, regulation or policy that prohibits, or has the effect of prohibiting, the connection or reconnection of a utility service to a customer based upon the type or source of energy to be delivered to the customer.

sponsored.t: Establishes the municipal asbestos abatement grant program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of environmental conservation, in conjunction with the department of health and the department of labor, to establish the municipal asbestos abatement grant program to provide financial assistance to municipalities for the abatement of asbestos in vacant and/or abandoned commercial properties; makes a $15,000,000 appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Relates to bills containing provisions requiring appointments to be made by the legislative leaders
sponsored.sum: Requires certain bills which establish a commission, task force, board, council or any similar body shall have not less than one position appointed by each of the legislative leaders.

sponsored.t: Creates a citizen advisory panel
sponsored.sum: Creates a citizen advisory panel consisting of six permanent and three rotating members to prepare a report on any application for certificate of any major electric generating facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to crimes committed against a child
sponsored.sum: Relates to crimes against a child; makes endangering the welfare of a child in the first degree a crime.

sponsored.t: Establishes the legislative sunset advisory commission
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York state legislative sunset act which establishes the legislative sunset advisory commission.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the New York state thruway authority accountability act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York state thruway authority accountability act; names the commissioner of DOT as chair of the thruway authority board; directs the commissioner of DOT to submit a plan to merge the thruway authority into the department of transportation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of records and information in the family court; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of records and information in the family court.

sponsored.t: Creates the division of regulatory review and economic growth
sponsored.sum: Creates the division of regulatory review and economic growth to review regulatory processes and permit requirements in order to facilitate economic growth; imposes a two-for-one rule reduction requirement.

sponsored.t: Relates to local opt-in of migrant housing
sponsored.sum: Provides that any requirement that undocumented immigrants who are seeking asylum in the United States be sheltered in a certain locality or localities shall only apply to those towns, cities, and counties that opt-in to such requirement through the adoption of a local law or ordinance; defines the term "sheltered" as including, but not limited to, being temporarily or permanently placed into housing, dwelling, or living quarters by a state or local governmental entity.

sponsored.t: Relates to registration fees for snowmobiles to be used on frozen bodies of water for sport fishing or for access to hunting or trapping lands solely
sponsored.sum: Provides registration fees for snowmobiles used on frozen bodies of water solely for sport fishing or for access to hunting or trapping lands.

sponsored.t: Relates to environmental assessment of historic preservation plan
sponsored.sum: Relates to the environmental assessment of a historic preservation plan; addresses environmental impact statements, dates for filing drafts of such statewide comprehensive historic preservation plan, funds available for historic preservation purposes, and the New York state archaeological survey assistance fund.

sponsored.t: Allows counties to opt out of providing certain optional Medicaid benefits to prospective beneficiaries
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the state to allow counties to opt out of the county cost of medical assistance payments to any new enrollees who have either never received such benefits or who have reenrolled after a period of absence; directs the commissioner of health to apply for any and all federal waivers required to implement the provisions of this subdivision.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of environmental conservation to promote education in hunting, fishing and outdoor education in high school physical education courses
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of environmental conservation to promote education in hunting, fishing and outdoor education in high school physical education courses.

sponsored.t: Requires the division of criminal justice services to check the wanted felon status and other information of people applying for public assistance
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of criminal justice services to check the wanted felon status and probation or parole violator status of people applying for public assistance.

sponsored.t: Relates to calculation of the earned income credit
sponsored.sum: Relates to calculation of the earned income credit for taxable years beginning in 2026, provides the applicable percentage shall be 45%.

sponsored.t: Relates to the powers, functions and duties of the New York state public authorities control board
sponsored.sum: Provides that minority members of the public authorities control board shall have voting privileges and shall act upon a unanimous vote.

sponsored.t: Requires that annual reports be distributed in electronic format only, unless otherwise requested by a member
sponsored.sum: Requires that annual department reports be distributed in electronic format only, unless otherwise requested by a member.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the New York state diplomas to home ownership program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state diplomas to homeownership assistance program; provides awards of up to fifteen thousand dollars to eligible applicants for repayment on student loans; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Provides an itemized deduction for expenses for course-mandated supplies for eligible college students paid by taxpayers
sponsored.sum: Provides an itemized deduction for expenses for course-mandated supplies for eligible college students paid by taxpayers.

sponsored.t: Establishes a training wage equal to eighty-five percent of the state minimum wage or one hundred percent of the federal minimum wage
sponsored.sum: Establishes a training wage equal to eighty-five percent of the state minimum wage or one hundred percent of the federal minimum wage, whichever is greater, that may be paid to a youth who has no prior job experience; provides that no youth may be paid a training wage for more than one hundred eighty days.

sponsored.t: Places a permanent moratorium on unfunded mandates
sponsored.sum: Places a permanent moratorium on unfunded mandates.

sponsored.t: Relates to licenses to carry and possess firearms for police officers
sponsored.sum: Relates to licenses to carry and possess firearms for police officers; authorizes police officers to apply for a firearms license that is valid throughout the state.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the addition or change to certain wage orders which would have the effect of requiring an employer to pay an employee for time not actually worked
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the addition or change to certain wage orders which would have the effect of requiring an employer to pay an employee for time not actually worked.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of education to promulgate regulations providing for the decertification of a teacher convicted of a felony
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of education to promulgate regulations that provide for the immediate decertification of any teacher who is convicted of a felony under NY law or any offense under the laws of another jurisdiction that would be a felony under NY law.

sponsored.t: Eliminates state sales and compensating use tax on motor fuels and diesel motor fuels and authorizes localities to eliminate such taxes; establishes various exemptions from sales and use tax
sponsored.sum: Eliminates state sales and compensating use taxes on motor fuels and diesel motor fuels; authorizes localities to eliminate such taxes at the local level; establishes various exemptions from New York's sales and use tax; provides for a sales tax exemption for housekeeping supplies and for ready-to-eat foods.

sponsored.t: Relates to lump sum appropriation allocation reform
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the lump sum allocation advisory committee (Part A); relates to requiring transparency, identification and disclosure of certain appropriations (Part B); relates to withholding the salaries of the governor, agency commissioners and deputy commissioners for failing to meet certain reporting deadlines (Part C); relates to creating a tax rate reduction board to look at personal income tax and corporate franchise tax rates (Part D); relates to conducting an audit of all state economic development programs (Part E); relates to prohibiting certain political contributions by individuals appointed to entities that oversee lump sum appropriations (Part F); relates to…

sponsored.t: Establishes a spending cap and increases the maximum capacity of the rainy day fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes a spending cap; increases the maximum capacity of the rainy day fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to the state board of parole membership, interviews with incarcerated individuals, and determination of parole
sponsored.sum: Allows for the removal of members of the state board of parole by a majority vote in the senate and the assembly; requires three or more members of such board personally interview potential parolees; requires that the determination to parole an incarcerated individual be unanimous.

sponsored.t: Provides for temporary exemptions to educational institutions from certain requirements related to the multi-occupancy bathrooms and locker rooms; and authorizes funding for related improvements
sponsored.sum: Provides for temporary exemptions to educational institutions from certain requirements related to the use of multi-occupancy bathrooms and locker rooms; authorizes the use of state building aid for related facility improvements.

sponsored.t: Requires lifetime post-release supervision for certain offenders; prohibits good behavior allowances against certain determinate sentences
sponsored.sum: Requires lifetime post-release supervision for offenders convicted of rape in the first degree, criminal sexual act in the first degree, aggravated sexual abuse in the first degree, course of sexual conduct against a child in the first and second degrees or sexual abuse in the first degree when the other person is less than eleven years old; prohibits good behavior allowances against a determinate sentence for a person convicted of any such crimes.

sponsored.t: Includes certain offenses in being eligible for bail, makes certain offenses eligible to be considered hate crimes, and increases the penalties for certain offenses
sponsored.sum: Includes aggravated threat of mass harm, making a threat of mass harm, aggravated harassment in the second degree, harassment in the first degree, menacing in the third degree, menacing in the second degree, menacing in the first degree, and aggravated harassment in the first degree in being eligible for bail; makes aggravated threat of mass harm and making a threat of mass harm eligible to be considered hate crimes; increases the penalties for aggravated threat of mass harm and making a threat of mass harm.

sponsored.t: Requires additional investigation of certain claims of abuse or maltreatment
sponsored.sum: Requires additional investigation when three or more claims of abuse or maltreatment of a child are made relating to the same person; requires such person to be investigated and evaluated at least once a year for the next five years from the date of the last report.

sponsored.t: Relates to excise tax on telecommunication services
sponsored.sum: Relates to excise tax on telecommunication services (Part A); relates to temporary municipal assistance sales and compensating use taxes for cities of one million or more on telecommunication services (Part B).

sponsored.t: Enacts Retain-NY by implementing tuition tax credits and increasing the amount of an allowable deduction
sponsored.sum: Relates to a tuition tax credit; increases the amount of an allowable deduction (Part A); reduces income by the amount of interest paid for student loans (Part B).

sponsored.t: Allows any qualified person to apply for voter registration and enrollment by application made with an application for any hunting or fishing license
sponsored.sum: Allows any qualified person to apply for voter registration and enrollment by application made with an application for any hunting or fishing license.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Oswego to impose an additional rate of sales taxes.
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Oswego to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Lieutenant Donald R. Hill
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Lieutenant Donald R. Hill in the city of Oswego, county of Oswego.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the city of Oswego to impose an additional rate of sales tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the city of Oswego to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes.
